This study uses data on U.S. 18-64 year olds from five major household surveys over the period 1999-2019 to investigate three specific questions. First, do different measures or the same indicator from different data sets consistently show how mental distress has changed over time? Second, how does the performance of single-item measures compare to those of psychometrically validated screeners based on multiple questions? Third, what are the benefits or potential costs of using different functional forms of these measures? The answers to these questions are as follows: 1) the estimated trends vary, often dramatically, across measures and, for the same indicator, across data sets and, as a result, some proxies provide a misleading understanding of how mental health has changed over time; 2) the single-item measures do as well or better than those based on multiple questions; 3) no single functional form demonstrates clear superiority over the others. After demonstrating these points, lessons are elucidated for researchers attempting to use survey data to examine trends in mental health.
abstract_zh: 考察心理健康随时间变化的一种方法是利用大型全国调查中的信息。尽管这些基于调查的指标在理论上具有价值，并已在先前研究中被广泛使用，但若干挑战可能限制其实用性，或要求在使用时格外谨慎。本研究利用1999-2019年间美国18-64岁人群的五项主要家庭调查数据，探讨三个具体问题：第一，不同数据集中的不同指标或同一指标是否一致地反映了心理困扰随时间的变化趋势？第二，单项指标的表现与基于多问题的心理测量学验证筛查工具相比如何？第三，使用这些指标的不同函数形式有何益处或潜在成本？研究结果如下：1）不同指标间，以及同一指标在不同数据集间，估计趋势存在显著差异，甚至差异巨大，导致部分代理指标对心理健康随时间变化的解读具有误导性；2）单项指标的表现不逊于甚至优于基于多问题的指标；3）没有任何单一函数形式表现出明显优于其他形式的优势。在阐明这些发现后，本文为试图利用调查数据研究心理健康趋势的研究者提炼了相关启示。
title: Estimating Trends In Mental Distress Using Survey Data
title_zh: 利用调查数据估算心理困扰趋势

abstract: Households' most consequential economic decisions are usually made jointly, yet behavioral interventions are typically targeted to individuals and optimized to overcome intra-personal constraints. We use a randomized controlled trial to study whether behavioral interventions targeted to couples can overcome interpersonal constraints related to intra-household decision-making. In rural Liberia, we layer a facilitated joint financial planning exercise atop a large unconditional cash transfer, assessing effects relative to cash only and a pure control. Relative to cash only, adding planning increases the amount of the transfer spent on productive investment and consequently improves economic outcomes by 0.16 standard deviation units. However, for households with the highest ex-ante conflict risk, these gains come at the cost of additional intimate partner violence.
abstract_zh: 家庭最重要的经济决策通常由夫妻共同做出，然而行为干预措施通常针对个人设计，并优化以克服个人内在约束。我们通过一项随机对照试验，研究针对夫妻的行为干预能否克服与家庭内部决策相关的人际约束。在利比里亚农村地区，我们在大规模无条件现金转移支付的基础上，增加了一项引导式联合财务规划练习，评估其相对于仅提供现金和纯对照组的效果。与仅提供现金相比，增加财务规划使转移支付中用于生产性投资的金额增加，进而使经济结果改善0.16个标准差单位。然而，对于事前冲突风险最高的家庭，这些收益是以增加亲密伴侣暴力为代价的。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象是利比里亚农村家庭，不涉及中国
title: Better Together? The Impact of Cash Transfers and Couples' Financial Planning on Household Dynamics and Economic Outcomes
title_zh: 携手共进？现金转移与夫妻财务规划对家庭动态及经济结果的影响

abstract: Health shocks are a major driver of retirement. However, the existing literature on this topic tends not to consider the marital context in which retirements occur. Using the 1992-2022 Health and Retirement Study and staggered difference-in-differences methods, we investigate how spousal health shocks impact retirement transitions. We also investigate whether these effects differ by gender and health insurance status. We consider multiple definitions of health shocks, including self-reported health declines, additional diagnoses, hospitalizations, increases in out-of-pocket medical spending, and functional deterioration. Our results suggest that the probability of retirement increases by 1.2 to 1.3 percentage points (12 to 13 percent) after a spouse’s new health condition diagnosis or hospitalization. These retirements tend to occur earlier than anticipated. They also tend to be concentrated among women and respondents with employment-based health plans that include retiree coverage for their spouse.
abstract_zh: 健康冲击是退休的主要驱动因素之一。然而，现有相关文献往往未考虑退休发生的婚姻背景。利用1992-2022年健康与退休研究数据及交错双重差分法，我们探究配偶健康冲击如何影响退休转变，并分析这些效应是否因性别和医疗保险状况而异。我们采用多种健康冲击定义，包括自评健康下降、新增诊断、住院治疗、自付医疗支出增加及功能退化。结果表明，配偶新诊断健康问题或住院后，个体退休概率上升1.2至1.3个百分点（12%至13%）。这些退休往往早于预期，且主要集中在女性及拥有包含配偶退休后医疗保险的就业型健康计划的受访者中。
title: In Sickness and in Health: Retirement Responses to Spousal Health Shocks
title_zh: 疾病与健康：配偶健康冲击对退休决策的影响

abstract: Employers facing limited labor market competition may suppress wages below socially optimal levels. Unions can counteract wage suppression through collective bargaining, though they may also push wages above the socially optimal level and lead to job rationing. We estimate a structural model of labor supply, labor demand, and Nash-in-Nash bargaining over wages between local teacher unions and school districts in Pennsylvania’s K-12 public school system from 2013 to 2019. We compare negotiated equilibrium wages and employment to oligopsony wage posting and social planner scenarios. On average, oligopsony reduces wages 7 percent below the social optimum, while collective bargaining raises wages 8 percent above it. Averages mask substantial district-level heterogeneity driven by bargaining power variation. Twenty-eight percent of school districts have salaries lower when public schools are unionized than when they are not due to cross-district externalities, where high salaries at one school cause hiring reductions that increase labor supply elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 面对劳动力市场竞争不足的雇主，可能会将工资压低至社会最优水平以下。工会可以通过集体谈判来抵消工资压制，但也可能将工资推高至社会最优水平以上，并导致工作岗位配给。我们构建了一个包含劳动力供给、劳动力需求以及纳什议价（Nash-in-Nash bargaining）的结构模型，用以分析2013年至2019年间宾夕法尼亚州K-12公立学校系统中地方教师工会与学区之间的工资谈判。我们将谈判达成的均衡工资和就业水平与寡头垄断工资设定及社会规划者情景进行比较。平均而言，寡头垄断使工资低于社会最优水平7%，而集体谈判则使工资高于社会最优水平8%。平均值掩盖了由议价能力差异导致的显著学区层面异质性。28%的学区在公立学校工会化后的工资水平反而低于非工会化状态，这是由于跨学区外部性所致：某一学区的高工资导致招聘减少，从而增加了其他学区的劳动力供给。
title: Oligopsony and Collective Bargaining
title_zh: 寡头买方与集体谈判

abstract: In monopsony models, wage markdowns induce deadweight loss and are therefore inefficient. Yet markdowns also arise in models with backloaded efficiency pay, where they are designed to induce effort among early-career workers and are thus efficient. To reconcile—and empirically distinguish—these two mechanisms, we build a dynamic model incorporating labor market power and endogenous effort. Estimating a team production model on novel data on U.S. public accounting firms, we find evidence of both: markdowns for junior workers and markups for senior ones reflect incentive-providing backloading, while monopsony power induces a ‘lifetime’ wage markdown of 15%.
abstract_zh: 在买方垄断模型中，工资折价会导致无谓损失，因此是低效的。然而，在具有后置效率薪酬的模型中，折价现象同样存在，其设计目的是激励早期职业员工付出努力，因此是高效的。为调和并实证区分这两种机制，我们构建了一个融合劳动力市场势力与内生努力的动态模型。基于美国会计师事务所的新数据集，我们通过团队生产模型估计发现两种机制并存：初级员工的折价与高级员工的溢价反映了激励导向的后置薪酬安排，而买方垄断势力则导致15%的"终身"工资折价。
title: Monopsony and Backloaded Compensation: Theory and Evidence from Public Accountants
title_zh: 买方垄断与延迟补偿：来自公共会计师的理论与证据

abstract: Prospective merger simulations are a commonly used tool in industrial organization and antitrust, but evidence about their accuracy and predictive ability is limited. We study 101 mergers in consumer packaged goods and compare the realizations of price changes with predictions from merger simulations. In our sample of consummated mergers, predicted price changes from merger simulations are typically larger than realized ones. Despite the overprediction, we find that full merger simulations are more effective than both structural presumptions and approximations of the merger effect at identifying mergers with large price changes.
abstract_zh: 前瞻性并购模拟是产业组织与反垄断领域常用的工具，但关于其准确性和预测能力的证据有限。我们研究了101个消费品包装行业的并购案例，将实际价格变化与并购模拟的预测结果进行对比。在已完成的并购样本中，并购模拟预测的价格变化通常大于实际发生的价格变化。尽管存在过度预测现象，但我们发现，相较于结构性假设和并购效应的近似估算，完整的并购模拟在识别具有较大价格变化的并购方面更为有效。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国消费品行业并购，数据、制度背景均非中国
title: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Merger Simulations
title_zh: 并购模拟的大规模评估

abstract: In recent years, there has been Congressional interest in changing various policies related to research and development (R&D). Recent legislation has included provisions that would modify federal funding for R&D investments and tax provisions affecting the after-tax price of R&D. The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) has developed analytical frameworks for estimating how changes in R&D investments affect the economy and the federal budget. This paper describes the agency’s current analytical framework for modeling the economic effects of changes in federal funding for R&D, focusing on two distinct approaches that CBO has developed: an R&D capital stock approach and an R&D components approach.
abstract_zh: 近年来，国会一直关注调整与研发相关的各项政策。近期立法中包含了修改联邦研发投资资金条款以及影响研发税后价格的税收条款。国会预算办公室（CBO）已建立分析框架，用于估算研发投资变化对经济和联邦预算的影响。本文阐述了该机构当前用于模拟联邦研发资金变化经济效应的分析框架，重点介绍CBO开发的两种不同方法：研发资本存量法和研发要素法。
title: Estimating the Economic Effects of Federally Funded R&D
title_zh: 联邦资助研发的经济效应估算

abstract: Many previous studies have used cross-cohort comparisons and a focus on in utero exposure to document the lingering effects of the 1918 influenza pandemic on survivors’ outcomes later in life. A subset has examined impacts on old-age health and mortality, finding mixed results. This paper contributes to the literature by extending the analysis to evaluate early-life and childhood exposure to the pandemic on old-age longevity along with a set of candidate mechanisms. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked to the full-count 1940 census and employ event-study and difference-in-difference regressions to compare longevity of cohorts with different age-at-exposure who were born in cities with high versus low exposure based on 1918 influenza-related mortality. Our treatment-on-treated calculations suggest that cohorts with age-at-exposure of 3-8 and 9-11 experience 6.4 and 11.2 months reductions in old age longevity; importantly, we note that these cohorts are often used as “controls” in the broader literature. While our main analysis focuses on males due to data constraints, supplementary results suggest smaller and less precise effects for females. An analysis of census data suggests reductions in health, education and socioeconomic scores as potential mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 许多先前研究通过跨队列比较并聚焦于子宫内暴露，记录了1918年流感大流行对幸存者晚年生活结果的持续影响。部分研究考察了其对老年健康与死亡率的影响，但结果不一。本文通过将分析扩展至评估早期生活及童年时期暴露于大流行对老年寿命的影响，并探讨一系列潜在机制，为现有文献做出贡献。我们利用与社会保障管理局死亡记录关联的1940年全量人口普查数据，采用事件研究法和双重差分回归，比较了不同暴露年龄队列的寿命差异——这些队列出生于1918年流感相关死亡率高或低的城市。基于处理效应的计算表明，暴露年龄为3-8岁和9-11岁的队列，其老年寿命分别缩短6.4个月和11.2个月；重要的是，我们注意到这些队列在更广泛的文献中常被用作“对照组”。由于数据限制，我们的主要分析聚焦于男性，但补充结果显示女性受到的影响较小且估计精度较低。对人口普查数据的分析表明，健康、教育及社会经济得分的下降是潜在机制。
title: Walking with Feet Tied to the Past: Childhood Exposure to the 1918 Influenza Pandemic and Later-Life Male Mortality
title_zh: 背负过往前行：童年经历1918年流感大流行与晚年男性死亡率

abstract: U.S. life expectancy stagnated and declined in the 2010s despite continued growth in real per capita income. We use Preston curves to characterize this pattern as a change in the relationship between income and longevity. Using state-level data from 1980 to 2019 and county-level data from 2000 to 2019, we estimate population-weighted Preston curves relating life expectancy to logged real per capita income. From 1980 to 2010, U.S. states followed the classic Preston curve pattern: rising income was accompanied by rising life expectancy. Counties followed the same pattern from 2000 to 2010. From 2010 to 2019, however, states and counties continued to become richer while life expectancy stagnated or declined. The curves shifted right without shifting up and became steeper, indicating decoupling and divergence: increases in aggregate resources over time no longer produced broad longevity gains, and, in any given year, inequality in life expectancy by income grew. These patterns are robust to alternative temporal anchors around the Great Recession and to substituting education for income. They also appear across sex and racial groups. County-level decompositions are broadly consistent with arguments that longevity has fallen due to widely shared exposures to social deterioration, which may account for the Preston curve reversal. Collectively, we show that the recent U.S. mortality crisis reveals a weakening—and growing inequality—in the conversion of aggregate resources into longevity gains. We conclude that the recent U.S. mortality crisis could be understood not only as a story about particular causes of death, but also as a weakening of institutional and social translation.
abstract_zh: 美国人均预期寿命在2010年代陷入停滞甚至下降，尽管实际人均收入持续增长。我们运用普雷斯顿曲线将这一模式刻画为收入与寿命关系的转变。基于1980-2019年州级数据与2000-2019年县级数据，我们估算了以人口加权的普雷斯顿曲线，该曲线将预期寿命与对数化实际人均收入相关联。1980-2010年间，美国各州遵循经典普雷斯顿曲线模式：收入增长伴随预期寿命提升。2000-2010年间各县亦呈现相同趋势。然而2010-2019年间，各州与各县收入持续增长，但预期寿命停滞或下降。曲线向右平移却未向上移动，且斜率增大，表明出现脱钩与分化：随时间推移的总体资源增长不再带来广泛的寿命增益，且在任意给定年份，不同收入群体的预期寿命不平等程度加剧。这些模式在围绕大衰退的替代时间锚点检验中保持稳健，并以教育替代收入后依然成立。该模式同样存在于不同性别与种族群体中。县级分解结果与"社会恶化导致的广泛暴露因素造成寿命下降"这一论点基本吻合，这或可解释普雷斯顿曲线的逆转。综合来看，我们揭示近期美国死亡率危机反映出总体资源向寿命增益转化的弱化——以及转化过程中日益加剧的不平等。我们得出结论：近期美国死亡率危机不仅可被理解为特定死因的故事，更可被视为制度与社会转化机制弱化的表征。
title: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
title_zh: 美国死亡率危机：普雷斯顿曲线的逆转

abstract: Germany experiences an increase in LTC recipients, due to population ageing but also to reforms which made LTC benefits easier accessible for individuals with cognitive impairments. Previous studies documented the cost of long-term care, and how it evolved. However, less is known about the specific case of elderly people suffering from cognitive impairment. Thus, we measure the economic costs of cognitive impairment, which include extensive medical, nursing care and at-home long-term care. We use the SHARE, the Survey on Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe, Wave 9. We observe 4% of elderly people living at home with severe cognitive impairment (SCI) (Langa et al. (2017) definition). These individuals are 30% more likely to receive any care, and obtain on average 6 more hours of formal care and 6 more hours of informal care per week. The main driver is not the cognitive impairment per-se but the limitation in activities of daily living (ADLs) which SCI leads to. Thus, once controlling for ADLs, SCI does not explain any additional probability to use care. However, because people with SCI are more likely to have ADLs, the annual cost of their care is estimated to 10,000 euros per year per individual on average.
abstract_zh: 德国长期护理受益人数增加，既源于人口老龄化，也源于改革使认知障碍者更易获得长期护理福利。既往研究记录了长期护理成本及其演变趋势，但针对认知障碍老年群体的具体情况仍知之甚少。为此，我们测算了认知障碍的经济成本，涵盖医疗、护理及居家长期护理等广泛领域。基于欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）第九轮数据，我们发现4%的居家老年人存在严重认知障碍（SCI）（采用Langa等（2017）定义）。这类人群接受护理的概率高出30%，每周平均多获得6小时正式护理和6小时非正式护理。主要驱动因素并非认知障碍本身，而是其导致的日常生活活动能力（ADLs）受限。因此，在控制ADLs后，SCI对护理使用概率不再具有额外解释力。但由于SCI患者更易出现ADLs受限，其人均年度护理成本估计达10,000欧元。
title: Severe Cognitive Impairments and Long-term Care in Germany
title_zh: 德国严重认知障碍与长期护理

title: Offshore dollar funding shocks and the dollar exchange rate
title_zh: 离岸美元融资冲击与美元汇率

abstract: Occupational licensing has attracted growing attention in advanced economies, yet little has been known about its prevalence outside the US. This column presents new evidence from 44 countries using nationally representative surveys. It shows that licensing is widespread around the world and, surprisingly, is often more common in developing economies than in richer nations. Higher occupational licensing is associated with lower per capita incomes and higher informal employment rates. These patterns suggest occupational licensing deserves greater attention as part of the broader debate over labour market regulation, informality, and economic development.
abstract_zh: 职业许可在发达经济体中日益受到关注，但对其在美国以外地区的普及程度却知之甚少。本文利用44个国家的全国代表性调查数据提供了新证据。研究表明，职业许可在全球范围内广泛存在，且令人意外的是，其在发展中国家的普及程度往往高于富裕国家。较高的职业许可率与较低的人均收入和较高的非正规就业率相关。这些模式表明，在关于劳动力市场监管、非正规经济与经济发展的更广泛讨论中，职业许可问题应得到更多关注。
title: Occupational licensing across countries: New evidence from 44 nations
title_zh: 跨国职业许可：来自44个国家的新证据

abstract: The dollar's role as the world's reserve currency has been blamed for an overvalued exchange rate that hollows out US manufacturing. This column quantifies what would happen if foreign investors stopped treating US safe assets as international liquidity. In a calibrated two-country model, the exchange-rate consequences are present but modest – a permanent real depreciation of roughly 9% – while the larger effects fall on US interest rates, which rise by around 90 basis points, and on national wealth, where the lost seigniorage is worth close to one year of GDP. The recent decline in convenience yields and foreign ownership of US public debt suggests the transition may already be under way.
abstract_zh: 美元作为全球储备货币的角色，被指责导致汇率高估，进而掏空了美国制造业。本文量化分析了如果外国投资者不再将美国安全资产视为国际流动性工具，将会发生什么。在一个经过校准的两国模型中，汇率影响确实存在但较为温和——实际汇率永久性贬值约9%——而更大的影响则体现在美国利率上，利率上升约90个基点，以及国民财富方面，损失的铸币税接近一年的GDP。近期便利收益率下降以及外国持有美国公共债务减少表明，这一转变可能已经开始。
authors: Zhengyang Jiang, Arvind Krishnamurthy, Hanno Lustig, Robert Richmond
title: Dollar erosion: The macroeconomic consequences of losing reserve currency status
title_zh: 美元侵蚀：失去储备货币地位的宏观经济后果

abstract: A buyer can learn about a product through search or seller-disclosed information. We examine how lower search costs or better seller disclosure affects this interaction. Whereas a drop in search costs improves consumer surplus and decreases profit when the seller can resort to an optimal disclosure strategy, its impact is ambiguous if the seller is unable to provide information. When it is unlikely that the buyer's valuation is below marginal cost, the buyer does not benefit from optimal information disclosure if search costs are high. With such high search costs and no disclosure both parties can be better off than with lower search costs and optimal information disclosure. The seller then adopts a mass market strategy where she posts a low enough price so the buyer always purchases the product without search. By contrast, if it is sufficiently likely that the buyer's valuation is below marginal cost, then the buyer can benefit from sophisticated information disclosure for relatively low search costs. The corresponding outcome is better for both parties than an environment with higher search costs and no information disclosure. The optimal seller strategy targets a niche of high-valuation buyers and prevents wasteful search by buyers with low valuations.
abstract_zh: 买方可通过搜索或卖方披露的信息了解产品。我们考察了搜索成本降低或卖方信息披露改善如何影响这一互动过程。当卖方能够采用最优信息披露策略时，搜索成本下降会提升消费者剩余并降低利润；但若卖方无法提供信息，其影响则具有不确定性。当买方估值低于边际成本的可能性较小时，若搜索成本较高，买方无法从最优信息披露中获益。在此高搜索成本且无信息披露的情况下，双方境况可能优于低搜索成本配合最优信息披露的情形——此时卖方采取大众市场策略，设定足够低的价格使买方无需搜索即可直接购买产品。相反，若买方估值低于边际成本的可能性足够大，则在相对较低的搜索成本下，买方可从精细化信息披露中获益。相较于高搜索成本且无信息披露的环境，该情形下的结果对双方更为有利。此时卖方的最优策略是瞄准高估值买方群体，同时避免低估值买方进行无效搜索。
title: Sources of Consumer Information
title_zh: 消费者信息来源

abstract: Marriage is declining in China. Among singles, the probability of marrying in 2019 was half that of marrying in 1999. We estimate a Choo and Siow (2006b) model using census data to quantify the relative roles of changes in population structure and changes in marital surplus, i.e., the value of marriage. We find that the increase in the supply of educated people explains half of the decline, partly due to a mismatch between highly-educated women and less-educated men. The deterioration of female-to-male ratio, known as marriage squeeze, explains an additional 13% for men. The decrease in surplus accounts for the remainder.
abstract_zh: 中国的婚姻率正在下降。在单身人群中，2019年结婚的概率仅为1999年的一半。我们利用人口普查数据估计了Choo和Siow（2006b）模型，以量化人口结构变化与婚姻剩余（即婚姻价值）变化的相对作用。研究发现，受教育人口增加解释了婚姻率下降的一半原因，部分源于高学历女性与低学历男性之间的婚配错位。女性与男性比例恶化（即婚姻挤压）对男性婚姻率下降的额外解释力为13%。剩余部分则由婚姻剩余减少所解释。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Left Over or Opting Out? Squeeze, Mismatch and Surplus in Chinese Marriage Markets
title_zh: 剩男还是主动退出？中国婚姻市场中的挤压、错配与剩余

abstract: We present a model of endogenous schooling and earnings to isolate the causal effect of parents' education on children's education and earnings outcomes. The model suggests that parents' education is positively related to children's earnings, but its relationship with children's education is ambiguous. Identification is achieved by comparing the earnings of children with the same length of schooling, whose parents have different lengths of schooling. The model also features heterogeneous preferences for schooling, and is estimated using HRS data. The observed correlation between parents' and children's years of schooling is largely driven by the correlation between parents' schooling and children's unobserved preferences for schooling. This is partly offset by a slightly negative, structural relationship between parents' and children's schooling choices, resulting in an IV coefficient smaller than OLS when exogenously increasing parents' schooling. Nonetheless, an exogenous one-year increase in parents' schooling raises children's lifetime earnings by 2 percent on average.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生教育年限与收入模型，以分离父母教育对子女教育及收入结果的因果效应。模型表明，父母教育与子女收入呈正相关，但与子女教育的关系并不明确。通过比较父母教育年限不同但子女受教育年限相同的个体收入，实现了因果识别。该模型还纳入了对教育偏好的异质性，并利用HRS数据进行估计。观察到的父母与子女教育年限的相关性，主要源于父母教育与子女未观测到的教育偏好之间的相关性。这一效应部分被父母与子女教育选择之间微弱的负向结构性关系所抵消，导致当外生提高父母教育年限时，工具变量估计系数小于普通最小二乘法。尽管如此，父母教育年限外生增加一年，仍能使子女终身收入平均提高2%。
authors: Sang Yoon (Tim) Lee; Nicolas Roys; Ananth Seshadri
title: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
title_zh: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应

abstract: We document the macroeconomic patterns that characterize labor market recovery from financial crises. Using a sample of postwar recession episodes from around the world, we show that financial crises are typically followed by jobless recoveries, with a sluggish recovery in employment relative to output. A departure from this empirical regularity occurs in emerging-market crises with high inflation, which feature strong employment recoveries but persistent declines in real wages and result in “wageless recoveries.” Our findings highlight the central role of financial components in labor input costs and nominal wage rigidities in shaping labor market dynamics following economic crises.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了金融危机后劳动力市场复苏的宏观经济特征。基于全球战后经济衰退案例样本，我们发现金融危机通常伴随无就业复苏，即就业相对于产出的恢复较为缓慢。这一经验规律在新兴市场高通胀危机中出现例外——此类危机呈现强劲的就业复苏，但实际工资持续下降，形成"无工资复苏"现象。研究结果凸显了劳动力投入成本中的金融成分与名义工资刚性在塑造经济危机后劳动力市场动态中的核心作用。
authors: Guillermo Calvo; Emilio Colombi; Fabrizio Coricelli; Pablo Ottonello
title: Labor Markets, Financial Crises, and Inflation: Jobless and Wageless Recoveries
title_zh: 劳动力市场、金融危机与通货膨胀：无就业与无工资复苏

abstract: We examine the economic geography of gender wage gaps to understand the role that location plays in gender earning differences. Using panelised administrative data for the universe of French workers, our findings indicate that women benefit relatively more from density than men, with an urban wage premium (return to urban density) 48% higher than for men. We identify a number of factors that explain this gap, with a large share being explained by the structure of the local labour market, notably, the extent of occupational segregation. Another important factor is commuting patterns, while childcare availability plays only a moderate role.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了性别工资差距的经济地理学，以理解地理位置在性别收入差异中的作用。利用法国全体劳动者的面板化行政数据，研究结果表明，女性从城市密度中获得的相对收益高于男性，其城市工资溢价（城市密度的回报率）比男性高出48%。我们识别出若干解释这一差距的因素，其中很大一部分归因于当地劳动力市场的结构，尤其是职业隔离的程度。另一个重要因素是通勤模式，而儿童保育的可获得性仅起到中等程度的作用。
authors: Kenza Elass; Cecilia García-Peñalosa; Christian Schluter
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为法国工人，数据为法国行政数据，不涉及中国
title: Gender Gaps in the Urban Wage Premium
title_zh: DP19592 城市工资溢价中的性别差距

abstract: Carbon pricing is a powerful but politically contentious tool for tackling climate change. Governments can, however, try to increase public support for it by adjusting how the revenues raised by the carbon price are used. In a fully incentivised experiment with a large representative sample of the German population, we compare voter support for five different carbon pricing schemes. We show that uniform carbon dividends (equal per capita transfers to all citizens) receive substantially more support than a carbon dividend that favours poorer people, than earmarking revenues for climate projects, and especially than using revenues for the general government budget. Among the uniform carbon dividend schemes, a Climate Premium that pays a fixed upfront transfer equal to the expected carbon revenues receives more support than a carbon dividend scheme where the size of the transfer is determined ex-post based on the actual revenues. Furthermore, we show that participants and experts underestimate public support for carbon pricing. These findings suggest that policies for sustainable development gain more support when affected voters are uniformly compensated for the costs imposed on them. In addition, the paper highlights the importance of incentivised experiments in studying public support for such policies.
abstract_zh: 碳定价是应对气候变化的有力但政治上具有争议性的工具。然而，政府可以通过调整碳定价所产生收入的用途来尝试提升公众对其的支持。在一项针对德国人口大规模代表性样本的完全激励实验中，我们比较了选民对五种不同碳定价方案的支持度。研究表明，统一碳红利（向所有公民按人均等额转移支付）获得的公众支持显著高于偏向贫困群体的碳红利、将收入专项用于气候项目，尤其是将收入纳入政府一般预算的方案。在统一碳红利方案中，预先支付相当于预期碳收入固定金额的"气候溢价"方案，比根据实际收入事后确定转移规模的碳红利方案获得更多支持。此外，我们发现参与者和专家均低估了公众对碳定价的支持度。这些发现表明，当受影响选民因政策成本获得统一补偿时，可持续发展政策能获得更多支持。同时，本文强调了激励实验在研究此类政策公众支持度中的重要性。
authors: Andrej Woerner; Taisuke Imai; Davide Pace; Klaus Schmidt
title: How to Increase Public Support for Carbon Pricing with Revenue Recycling
title_zh: DP19590 如何通过收入循环提高公众对碳定价的支持

abstract: We study the role of heterogenous preferences at the spousal level and that of spousal mutual insurance against wage shocks for couples’ labor supply in a time-use model. We estimate the model for couples in the German Time-Use Survey with Bayesian techniques and generate gender-specific wage-elasticities of market hours in the cross-section and for all couples. Missing mutual insurance ignores males’ behavior which we find to be substantial. Together with preference heterogeneity it shapes the elasticities’ size and distribution, especially for high and low hours worked and wage groups. Our setting is suitable to analyze nonlinear and distributional economic policy.
abstract_zh: 本文在时间利用模型中研究了配偶层面异质性偏好以及配偶间工资冲击相互保险对夫妻劳动供给的作用。我们采用贝叶斯方法，基于德国时间利用调查数据对模型进行估计，并生成了截面层面及所有夫妻的性别特异性市场工时工资弹性。缺失相互保险会忽略男性的行为，而我们的研究发现这种行为影响显著。与偏好异质性共同作用，这种缺失塑造了弹性的大小与分布，尤其在高、低工时及工资群体中表现突出。我们的研究框架适用于分析非线性及分布性经济政策。
authors: Monika Merz; Almut Balleer; Tamás K. Papp
title: Heterogeneous preferences, spousal interaction, and couples' time-use
title_zh: DP19587 异质性偏好、配偶互动与夫妻时间利用

abstract: We find consistent evidence across ratings and regions that delta-hedged credit index options have large negative Sharpe ratios and much more so than their equity index counterparts. Risk-factors extracted from equity index options have only moderate explanatory power for the time-series and cross-sectional variation in credit option returns, while a single credit-specific factor explains much of the remaining variation. We link this factor to credit option order flow in a manner that is consistent with the predictions of a demand-based option pricing model, where order-flow risk is priced in equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 我们通过评级和地区的一致证据发现，Delta对冲的信用指数期权具有较大的负夏普比率，且其负值程度远超股票指数期权。从股票指数期权中提取的风险因子对信用期权收益的时间序列和截面变化的解释力有限，而一个单一的信用特定因子则解释了剩余的大部分变化。我们将该因子与信用期权订单流联系起来，这一关联符合基于需求的期权定价模型的预测，在该模型中，订单流风险在均衡状态下被定价。
title: Pricing of Risk in Credit and Equity Index Options - A Role for Option Order Flow?
title_zh: 信用与股票指数期权中的风险定价——期权订单流的作用？

abstract: This paper examines whether financial incentives for general practitioners (GPs) can effectively replace patient cost-sharing within a gatekeeper healthcare system in which the GP regulates access to specialist care. We estimate the effects of incentives provided to GPs by exploiting a field experiment in which treated GPs received a share of the cost savings they achieved. There was also a set of control practices. The patient population includes about 26,000 individuals and is largely representative of the overall population in the Netherlands. We estimate the effects of incentives for patients provided by a deductible using a simulated instrumental variables approach. For both sets of analyses, we use the same measures of healthcare costs, the same time period, and the same population of patients. Our findings show that the incentives provided to GPs reduce costs by 4.3 percent, mainly by decreasing less-urgent specialist care. A small patient deductible of 375 euros per year reduces costs by 27.8 percent in each month in which patients still have to pay out-of-pocket and 10.4 percent at the annual level, impacting all types of care. In contrast, physicians discriminate by type and priority of care. We do not find clear patterns for the interaction of incentives provided to GPs and patients. Our results suggest that GP incentives may complement but not fully replace patient deductibles in managing healthcare costs effectively.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨在由全科医生（GP）控制专科医疗服务准入的守门人医疗体系中，对全科医生的经济激励能否有效替代患者费用共担机制。我们通过一项田野实验评估对全科医生的激励效果：实验组全科医生可获得其实现的成本节约份额，同时设置对照组。患者样本约2.6万人，在荷兰总体人口中具有较高代表性。我们采用模拟工具变量法，估计免赔额对患者的激励效应。两组分析均使用相同的医疗成本指标、时间区间及患者群体。研究结果表明：对全科医生的激励使医疗成本降低4.3%，主要通过减少非紧急专科服务实现；而每年375欧元的小额患者免赔额，在患者仍需自付费用的月份中每月降低27.8%的成本，年度层面降低10.4%，且影响所有类型的医疗服务。相比之下，医生会根据护理类型和优先级进行差异化调整。我们未发现全科医生与患者激励之间存在清晰的交互作用模式。研究结论表明，在有效管理医疗成本方面，全科医生激励措施可补充但无法完全替代患者免赔额制度。
title: Is physician cost-sharing an alternative to patient cost-sharing?
title_zh: 医生费用分摊是患者费用分摊的替代方案吗？

abstract: Foreign activities of MNEs have important effects on home economies. The debate is ambiguous: concerns that foreign investments deplete domestic economies are often coupled with the pride for doing good business in foreign countries. This Paper addresses this question by defining the appropriate counterfactual: what would have happened to investing firms if they had not invested abroad. It applies propensity score matching to derive these hypothetical performance trajectories from a sample of national firms which have never invested abroad. For a sample of Italian firms, it finds that investments improve growth of total factor productivity and output. It also finds no significant effects on employment. These results support the view that foreign investments strengthen rather than deplete home activities.
abstract_zh: 跨国公司的海外活动对母国经济具有重要影响。相关争论存在分歧：一方面担忧海外投资会削弱国内经济，另一方面又为在海外成功开展业务感到自豪。本文通过界定恰当的反事实情景来探讨这一问题：若企业未进行海外投资，其发展轨迹将会如何？研究采用倾向得分匹配法，从从未进行海外投资的国内企业样本中推导出这些假设性的绩效轨迹。基于意大利企业样本的分析发现，海外投资促进了全要素生产率和产出的增长，但对就业未产生显著影响。这些结果支持了海外投资强化而非削弱母国经济活动的观点。
title: Investments Abroad and Performance at Home: Evidence from Italian Multinationals
title_zh: 海外投资与国内绩效：来自意大利跨国企业的证据

abstract: In this Paper we incorporate the term structure of interest rates in a standard inflation forecast targeting framework. Learning about the transmission process of monetary policy is introduced by having heterogeneous agents - i.e. the central bank and private agents - who have different information sets about the future sequence of short-term interest rates. We analyse inflation forecast targeting in two environments. One in which the central bank has perfect knowledge, in the sense that it understands and observes the process by which private sector interest rate expectations are generated, and one in which the central bank has imperfect knowledge and has to learn the private sector forecasting rule for short-term interest rates. In the case of imperfect knowledge, the central bank has to learn about private sector interest rate expectations, as the latter affect the impact of monetary policy through the expectations theory of the term structure of interest rates. Here following Evans and Honkapohja (2001), the learning scheme we investigate is that of least-squares learning (recursive OLS) using the Kalman filter. We find that optimal monetary policy under learning is a policy that separates estimation and control. Therefore, this model suggests that the practical relevance of the breakdown of the separation principle and the need for experimentation in policy may be limited.
abstract_zh: 本文将利率期限结构纳入标准的通胀预测目标框架。通过引入异质性主体（即中央银行与私人部门），两者对未来短期利率序列拥有不同的信息集，从而引入货币政策传导过程的学习机制。我们在两种环境下分析通胀预测目标：其一，中央银行具备完全知识，即其理解并观测私人部门利率预期生成过程；其二，中央银行存在不完全知识，需学习私人部门短期利率预测规则。在不完全知识情形下，中央银行必须学习私人部门利率预期，因为后者通过利率期限结构的预期理论影响货币政策传导效果。此处遵循Evans和Honkapohja（2001）的研究，我们采用基于卡尔曼滤波的最小二乘学习（递归OLS）方案。研究发现，学习条件下的最优货币政策是分离估计与控制的政策。因此，本模型表明，分离原则失效及政策实验需求的实践相关性可能有限。
authors: Eric Schaling; Sylvester Eijffinger; Mewael F. Tesfaselassie
title: Heterogenous Information About the Term Structure of Interest Rates, Least-Squares Learning and Optimal Interest Rate Rules
title_zh: 利率期限结构的异质性信息、最小二乘学习与最优利率规则

abstract: We analyse how a firm allocates information rights across its multiple banks. By differentiating information disclosed, a firm prevents its banks from continuing projects (possibly unsound) solely in order to use their superior information and seize assets during the reorganization. Informational diversity can also lead to the premature liquidation of sound projects, however. We derive the optimal allocation of information as a function of the redeployability and the heterogeneity of the firm?s assets, and of the costs of restructuring the firm in distress. Using a sample of US firms, we find evidence that supports the empirical predictions of the model.
abstract_zh: 本文分析企业如何在其多家银行之间分配信息权。通过区分所披露的信息，企业可防止其银行仅为了利用自身信息优势并在重组期间夺取资产而继续（可能不健全的）项目。然而，信息多样性也可能导致健全项目被过早清算。我们推导出信息的最优分配，该分配取决于企业资产的可重新部署性、异质性以及企业陷入困境时的重组成本。基于美国企业样本，我们发现了支持模型实证预测的证据。
title: Multiple Creditors and Information Rights: Theory and Evidence from US Firms
title_zh: 多个债权人及信息权：来自美国企业的理论与证据

title: DP522 Exchange Rate Dynamics Under Stochastic Regime Shifts: A Unified Approach
title_zh: DP522 随机体制转换下的汇率动态：一个统一方法

title: DP521 Spain's Industrial Exports to the EEC: A Panel Data Approach
title_zh: DP521 西班牙对欧共体的工业出口：面板数据分析

title: DP520 German Reunification and Exchange Rate Policy in the EMS
title_zh: DP520 德国统一与欧洲货币体系中的汇率政策

title: DP519 Dynamic Seigniorage Theory: An Exploration
title_zh: DP519 动态铸币税理论：一项探索

abstract: This paper studies the merits of policy rules with escape clauses, analysing as an example fixed exchange rate systems that allow member countries the freedom to realign in periods of stress. Motivating this example is the debate within the European Monetary System over how quickly to move from the current regime of national currencies, linked by pegged but adjustable exchange rates, to a single European currency. The paper's main point is that while well-designed rules with escape clauses can raise society's welfare in principle, limited credibility makes it difficult for governments to implement such rules in practice. An EMS-type institution which presumably imposes a political cost on policy-makers who realign may lead to an optimal escape-clause equilibrium, but may just as well lead to alternative equilibria far inferior to an irrevocably fixed exchange rate. Countries can suffer periods in which no realignment occurs, yet unemployment, real wages, and ex post real interest rates remain persistently and sub-optimally high.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了带有例外条款的政策规则的优劣，并以允许成员国在压力时期自由调整汇率的固定汇率制度为例进行分析。这一例子的动机源于欧洲货币体系内部关于应从当前由可调整钉住汇率联结的国家货币体系，以多快速度过渡到单一欧洲货币的争论。本文的核心观点是：尽管设计良好的例外条款规则在理论上能够提升社会福利，但有限的可信度使得政府在实践中难以实施此类规则。一个类似欧洲货币体系的制度安排，若对进行汇率调整的政策制定者施加政治成本，可能会产生最优的例外条款均衡，但也同样可能导致远不如不可撤销的固定汇率制度的替代均衡。各国可能经历无汇率调整的时期，但失业率、实际工资以及事后实际利率却持续处于次优的高位。
title: DP518 Destabilizing Effects of Exchange-Rate Escape Clauses
title_zh: DP518 汇率逃避条款的不稳定效应

title: DP517 Adjustment Difficulties within a European Monetary Union: Can They be Reduced?
title_zh: DP517 欧洲货币联盟内部的调整困难：能否缓解？

abstract: The paper examines the possible motivations behind the plea for fiscal rules in the Delors Report. We argue that coordination problems arising from aggregate demand spillovers cannot be solved by means of budget rules and that in any case they are not important in Europe. We then discuss the notion of structural fiscal imbalances and show that potential solvency is a problem for some European countries, probably made more severe by EMU. Membership of countries with unsustainable positions may represent a risk for the stability of the union because of financial spillovers. Neither monetary discipline enforced by a `conservative' European Central Bank nor market discipline will by themselves prevent fiscal indiscipline or insulate the union from its consequences. Specific sanctions are needed to affect political choices by creating a trade-off between debt and monetary stability. The most effective sanction in our view would be a no-entry clause, such that membership is made contingent upon specifically defined changes in the fiscal positions of the countries concerned.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了《德洛尔报告》中倡导财政规则的可能动机。我们认为，由总需求溢出效应引发的协调问题无法通过预算规则解决，且此类问题在欧洲并不显著。随后，我们讨论了结构性财政失衡的概念，并指出部分欧洲国家存在潜在偿付能力问题，而经济货币联盟可能加剧这一困境。由于金融溢出效应，财政不可持续的国家加入联盟可能对联盟稳定性构成风险。无论是通过“保守型”欧洲中央银行实施的货币纪律，还是市场纪律，都无法单独遏制财政失范行为，或使联盟免受其后果影响。需要制定具体制裁措施，通过建立债务与货币稳定之间的权衡关系来影响政治决策。我们认为，最有效的制裁措施是设置准入条款，即成员国资格需以相关国家财政状况的特定变革为前提条件。

abstract: We test for evidence that US trade policy depends on the degree of government discretion. We do this by studying US tariff choices under two distinct environments. One is that of tariffs set under the Escape Clause (section 201 of the US Trade Act of 1974). The other is the Tokyo Round of GATT negotiations and the determination of the set of exclusions from the general formula cuts. We argue that the second environment provides much more capacity to commit than the first one. Comparing decisions made in these two environments allows us to ask whether the degree of policy commitment has a measurable impact on trade policy. Our findings suggest that it does.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了美国贸易政策是否取决于政府自由裁量权的程度。为此，我们研究了两种不同环境下的美国关税选择：其一是根据《1974年贸易法》第201条“逃避条款”设定的关税；其二是GATT东京回合谈判中，从通用公式减让中确定排除清单的过程。我们认为，第二种环境比第一种环境提供了更强的承诺能力。通过比较这两种环境下的决策，我们得以探究政策承诺程度是否对贸易政策产生可衡量的影响。研究结果表明，这种影响确实存在。

abstract: The paper shows that the conversion from national currency bank notes to hard-ECU notes is promoted by the provision of an implicit and free currency call option. This wealth effect is caused by the devaluation-proof definition of this currency. Nevertheless, additional transactions and information costs would keep the demand for hard-ECUs very limited. Because of such externalities the market does not lead to a Pareto-efficient arrangement for the European monetary order. At best the hard-ECU would out-compete currencies of EC countries with above-average inflation rates, while national currencies would remain in use in the other EC countries. In addition, the competition process is distorted by the subsidy character of the implicit option. The scheme is intended to enhance monetary stability in Europe, but the need for such an additional nominal anchor is not clear, nor is any reason why the Hard-ECU Bank should have an an extremely strong stability orientation. Moreover, a deliberate interest rate policy of the HEB, which would be required to discipline national central banks, conflicts with the main target of using the market as an exploratory device for identifying an optimum European monetary order.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，通过提供一种隐性且免费的货币看涨期权，可促进从国家货币纸币向硬埃居纸币的转换。这种财富效应源于该货币的抗贬值定义。然而，额外的交易成本与信息成本将使硬埃居的需求极为有限。由于此类外部性，市场无法为欧洲货币秩序带来帕累托有效的安排。在最理想的情况下，硬埃居仅能击败通胀率高于平均水平的欧共体国家货币，而其他欧共体国家仍将保留本国货币。此外，隐性期权的补贴性质扭曲了竞争过程。该方案旨在增强欧洲的货币稳定性，但引入这一额外名义锚的必要性尚不明确，亦无理由认为硬埃居银行应具备极强的稳定性导向。此外，为约束各国央行而需实施的刻意利率政策，与利用市场作为探索工具以识别最优欧洲货币秩序的主要目标相冲突。

abstract: Inspections are a common tool for acquiring information and incentivizing compliance. Though typically unannounced, they often follow a predictable schedule. We study how this predictability shapes firm effort and patient outcomes in U.S. nursing homes. Nursing homes “slack” in the low-risk period following an inspection and ramp up effort as their next inspection approaches. Patient survival mirrors this pattern, suggesting meaningful consequences for care quality. We embed these estimates in a dynamic model capturing how inspection regimes incentivize effort and reveal quality. Unpredictability induces as much additional effort as increasing inspection frequency by 10 percent, with minimal loss of informational value.
abstract_zh: 检查是获取信息和激励合规的常用工具。尽管通常不事先通知，但检查往往遵循可预测的时间表。我们研究了这种可预测性如何影响美国养老院的努力程度和患者结局。养老院在检查后的低风险期会“松懈”，并在下一次检查临近时加大努力。患者生存率也呈现相同模式，表明这对护理质量具有重要影响。我们将这些估计值嵌入一个动态模型中，该模型捕捉了检查制度如何激励努力并揭示质量。不可预测性所引发的额外努力，相当于将检查频率提高10%的效果，且信息价值的损失极小。
title: Predictably Unpredictable Inspections
title_zh: 可预测的不可预测检查

abstract: In the first part of the paper we outline a method for estimating a class of models in which news or surprises appear and expectations are formed rationally. The method is an extension of the errors-in-variables method of McCallum and Wickens. As a by-product some of Pagan's results on the circumstances under which the commonly use two-step method of estimating surprise models is efficient are shown to be a consequence of well-known theorems on the efficiency of sub-system estimation when a subset of equations is exactly identified. In the second part of the paper the method is applied to Hall's random-walk model of consumption, which is extended to allow for stochastic interest rates and for leisure and government spending to be substitutes for private spending. The extended formulation is a great deal more successful at capturing the salient features of the data. We also derive approximate restrictions across the parameters of the model due to the rational expectations hypothesis but find that they are marginally rejected by the data. Finally, we evaluate the ability of the life-cycle with rational expectations model to encompass alternative models.
abstract_zh: 本文第一部分概述了一种估计包含新闻或意外冲击且预期理性形成的模型类别的方法。该方法是对McCallum与Wickens变量误差法的扩展。作为副产品，本文证明了Pagan关于常用两步法估计意外模型有效性的部分结论，实为子方程组恰好识别时子系统估计效率经典定理的推论。第二部分将该方法应用于Hall的消费随机游走模型，通过引入随机利率、休闲与政府支出对私人支出的替代效应进行扩展。扩展后的模型在捕捉数据关键特征方面显著提升。我们进一步推导了理性预期假设下模型参数的近似约束条件，但发现这些约束被数据轻微拒绝。最后，本文评估了理性预期生命周期模型对其他竞争性模型的涵盖能力。

abstract: Much of the controversy about labour migration concerns an aspect which is not easily measured, the 'quality' of the flow. The first part of the paper applies logit analysis to a sample of emigrants from an Irish border county for some insight on the issue. The results suggest that while those who leave are relatively better educated than their neighbours, kinship variables such as parental attitudes and emigrant sponsors, are also important. The second part of the paper weighs 'life-cycle' losses from post-war Irish migration against receipts from emigrant tourism and remittances. It turns out that these items make a big dent in the losses.
abstract_zh: 关于劳动力迁移的诸多争议集中于一个难以衡量的方面，即迁移流的“质量”。论文第一部分运用逻辑回归分析，对来自爱尔兰边境郡的移民样本进行考察，以探究该问题。结果表明，尽管离境者相较于其邻人受教育程度更高，但亲属关系变量（如父母态度与移民担保人）同样具有重要影响。第二部分则权衡了战后爱尔兰移民的“生命周期”损失与移民旅游及汇款收入。结果显示，这些收入显著抵消了部分损失。

abstract: One of the aims of government policy has been to speed up the diffusion of new technologies. This aim has been pursued largely by policies aimed at improving information about the technology or by subsidising the purchase of new technology. In this paper we construct a simple diffusion model that integrates the two dominant themes in the literature, one stressing learning and the other stressing differences between potential adopters. We investigate the impact of learning and subsidy policies on the diffusion path and the welfare implications of these policies. It is argued that the market structure of the industry supplying the new technology is a key factor determining the impacts of the policies. It should therefore be considered when choosing whether government should intervene and if so, what instruments should be used.
abstract_zh: 政府政策的目标之一是加速新技术的扩散。这一目标主要通过改善技术信息或补贴新技术购买的政策来实现。本文构建了一个简单的扩散模型，整合了文献中的两大主流主题：一个强调学习，另一个强调潜在采用者之间的差异。我们研究了学习政策和补贴政策对扩散路径的影响，以及这些政策的福利含义。研究表明，供应新技术的行业市场结构是决定政策影响的关键因素。因此，在选择政府是否干预以及采用何种工具时，应充分考虑这一因素。

abstract: Were cash benefits and welfare services available to the unemployed sufficient to protect them from ill-health? Recent reappraisals have tended to magnify the influence of welfare provision. The present review draws on hitherto unexploited, confidential reports of the Ministry of Health and Board of Education, to point out that expert witnesses were increasingly concerned that unemployment relief and social services were inadequate to meet the needs of the community in 'Special Areas'. It is argued that the value of cash benefits was undermined by operation of the means test, and that welfare services were most inadequate where the need was greatest.
abstract_zh: 失业者获得的现金补助和福利服务是否足以保护他们免受健康损害？近期重新评估倾向于夸大福利供给的影响。本文基于此前未被利用的卫生部与教育部机密报告指出，专家证人日益担忧失业救济与社会服务不足以满足"特别地区"社区的需求。研究表明，现金补助的价值因经济状况调查的实施而遭到削弱，而福利服务在最需要的地方却最为匮乏。

abstract: The substantial rise in the proportion of elderly (65+) people in the British population over the last hundred years has been matched by a dramatic fall in labour-force participation rates among the elderly. Some commentators see the reduction in work opportunities for the eldery and their increasing reliance on state pensions to avoid poverty as a deliberate construct of successive governments. This paper shows that the economic dependency of the elderly is more clearly a function of long-established employment practices and patterns of asset accumulation. Information drawn from the decennial censuses since 1881 on the occupations of elderly males shows a consistent marginalization of elderly workers in low-wage, low-status occupations. Data on asset-holdings demonstrate that the elderly have a high probability of spending their last years in poverty. This casts doubt on the appropriateness of the life-cycle savings model as a description of the savings behaviour of most workers in 20th century Britain.
abstract_zh: 过去一百年间，英国65岁以上老年人口比例显著上升，与此同时老年人口劳动参与率急剧下降。部分评论者认为，老年人工作机会减少及其对国家养老金依赖度的加深以避免贫困，是历届政府刻意构建的结果。本文表明，老年人的经济依赖性更清晰地源于长期形成的雇佣惯例与资产积累模式。基于1881年以来十年一次的人口普查中老年男性职业信息显示，老年工人持续被边缘化至低工资、低地位职业。资产持有数据表明，老年人晚年陷入贫困的概率极高。这一发现对生命周期储蓄模型作为20世纪英国多数工人储蓄行为描述的适用性提出了质疑。
